facts.value: The agency invites qualified redevelopment proposals, including fee-simple purchase. It also considers ground leases.
The former building was demolished. An environmental remedial action plan is part of the solicitation.
Proposals must include an affordable-housing component. The agency board must approve the transfer.
For general reference, planning and guidance only. The outline is not a legal boundary or a professional survey.
Outline from the Rhode Island Department of Environmental Management GIS, matched by parcel number
